Definition: from G3772 and the enclitic of source; from the sky:--from heaven.
BiblicalUsage: From heaven is where the good things come down. God gave rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness, and Paul saw a light from heaven above the brightness of the sun on the road to Damascus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rain from heaven is the witness no one can argue with: God left Himself a testimony in the seasons, in the food, and in gladness.
